$comment: Rhythm/position/motion/asset rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule names the function that enforces it; extraction/verify_all.py::check_graph_validator_agreement asserts each named function exists and that every derived set still equals what templates.json says.

NO_HERO_TEMPLATES.derivation: templates with no hero-category node (their opening block carries the H1 itself)

SECONDARY_HERO_USES.derivation: (section, variant) hero-category nodes that are NOT the first content node on a real template; exempt from ONE_HERO_PER_PAGE

REAL_SAME_CATEGORY_PAIRS.derivation: same-category adjacencies that occur in some real realization of a template (optional slots in/out, choices resolved)

REAL_MAX_PER_PAGE.derivation: most occurrences of each (section, variant) on any real template

rules.rule: A PageSpec's nodes[] must match, in order, the node list of the template its 'template' field DECLARES (required / repeatable / choice slots honoured). Cross-references the declared template; never inspects nodes[] in isolation.
A node filling a slot that lists `variants` must carry one of them as content.variant ('default' = the homepage branch, which has no variant field). Keys structural matching on (section, variant).
PageSpec.theme must equal the declared template's theme (nimbus-content only on the content-theme templates).
A route outside the declared template's measured routes is allowed -- a generated page may live elsewhere -- but is FLAGGED.
shell.nav must be node 0 (Layout.jsx renders it before every page).
shell.footer must be the last node.
Exactly one footer CTA block per page: conversion.demo-form (the 'home' footer variant, '/' and '/company') or conversion.demo-cta (every other route), immediately before shell.footer.
conversion.demo-form sits immediately after conversion.faq and immediately before shell.footer (both real pages carrying it end FAQ -> form -> footer card inside one <footer>).
conversion.demo-cta sits immediately before shell.footer (Footer.jsx renders both).
proof.testimonial sits immediately after proof.results-stats: they share one container and one component (Results.jsx).
hero.logos-overlap sits immediately after hero.wow-content (its negative top margin pulls it up over that empty 'corporate' wowcontent block).
On a template that has a hero, node 1 (right after the nav) is a hero-category node. Templates in derivedSets.NO_HERO_TEMPLATES open with the index/article block that carries the H1.

At most one hero-category node, not counting the (section, variant) pairs in derivedSets.SECONDARY_HERO_USES (real secondary uses: the mid-page layout2 card on /company, the overlapping logos hero on /lms/corporate-lms); and at least one unless the template is in NO_HERO_TEMPLATES.
rules.exception: Both exception sets are DERIVED from templates.json and re-checked by verify_all.py::check_graph_validator_agreement.

rules.rule: Each (section, variant) may appear at most constraints.maxPerPageByVariant[variant] (else maxPerPage) times -- derived from the real templates (derivedSets.REAL_MAX_PER_PAGE), e.g. product.release-block 6 on the release page, story.marquee 'plain' 4 on /mentoring.
Two adjacent nodes of the same category are flagged, except the pairs adjacent on some real page.
motion.pattern must be in the section's allowedPatterns. Scroll reveals exist ONLY as scroll.revealOnce on the subpage sections that really have one; the homepage has none.
Every node declares reducedMotionFallback, equal to the section contract's const. Required for generated pages even though the source implements none.
Optional motion.trigger / durationMs / delayMs / easing must be values MEASURED for that pattern in tokens/00-foundation/motion.json (a value valid for another pattern is rejected).
Every media object's assetRole is in the closed enum AND in that field's own allowed roles; roles with exposedAsPageSpecField:false never appear.
assetRef is accepted only for may-generate-new and may-reuse-licensed roles; must-not-reuse / must-not-fabricate roles render a neutral placeholder and carry no file reference.
An assetRef of the form stock/<id>.jpg is accepted only with assetRole stock.photo (and only on fields that list stock.photo).
No string anywhere in a PageSpec may reference /assets/, public/assets/ or an http(s) URL.
The nine real-third-party roles hold their exact pinned generationPolicy, and stock.photo holds may-reuse-licensed, in assets/asset-roles.json and the allowlist.
No PageSpec string may contain the original brand/assistant names or the real third-party names listed in assets/asset-roles.json -> bannedTerms. Copy must be original placeholder copy.

Every form object (demo form, contact form, demo-hero form, subscribe/sign-up forms) has live:false; no action/endpoint/method/portalId/formId/hubspot/onSubmit/submitUrl field may appear anywhere in a PageSpec.
Video fields carry no embed/iframe/autoplay/youtube field: the video is a static placeholder making no network request.
Every linkPhrases / boldPhrases entry occurs verbatim in its sibling text.
Every text field respects its maxWords budget, per instance.
Every PageSpec `tokens` value is a real path of tokens/llm/token-catalog.json and every slot is a slot of tokens/llm/token-policy.json.
No raw colour (hex, rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), CSS colour keyword) in a token slot or in any node content string; colours are color.* / semantic.* tokens.
No raw length (px, rem, em, vh, vw, pt, %, calc()) in a token slot, and no CSS length in any node content string; spacing is a space.* / layout.* token.
Font slots accept only fontFamily.* catalog tokens (fontFamily.serif for headings, fontFamily.sans for body); a family name or stack is rejected.
A real token must also be one the slot allows (token-policy pageSpecTokenSlots.<slot>.allow).
Tokens listed in token-policy notGenerationApproved (declared but never rendered by the clone) are not usable.

Allowed theme/token combinations: the theme is a catalog theme; a themeResolved slot names a semantic token the theme resolves; themeScope tokens are used only in their themes (color.content-yellow: nimbus-content; color.brand-blue: nimbus-dark); text reaches 4.5:1 contrast on the surface in the declared theme.
mode=generation: no source brand (Nimbus, Nova, Thrive, Kiki, source hosts) anywhere in the page, the route or brand.name, and no brand.wordmark asset role.
mode=generation: only generation-safe asset roles (assets/asset-roles.json availability, pinned in code); no clone stock set (assetRef stock/...), no source asset file name.
mode=generation: no source person name (the clone's named testimonial people) and no photo.person role; use person.fictional.
mode=generation: no real or clone customer/company name and no logo.customer role; use logo.placeholderCompany.
mode=generation: no product.screenshot / product.video role; use screenshot.placeholder.
mode=generation: no 5-token run shared with the source copy (hashed shingles of src/ copy, CLONE_SPEC quotes and the clone examples).
mode=generation: no source statistic, price or figure (stat:/value:/price: values of src/).
mode=generation: no source host, and every host or e-mail domain in the page is on a reserved .example / .invalid domain.
mode=generation: no source embed (video embed URL or id, form portalId / formId).
mode=generation: no source CTA label that carries the source brand (e.g. 'See Nimbus in action').

Every asset role holds the availability pinned in code (semantic_validate.PINNED_AVAILABILITY == verify_all.PINNED_AVAILABILITY); non-safe roles list generation-safe substitutes; the allowlist copy agrees. A registry edit alone fails every PageSpec validation.

retrievalEligible on every section/component contract and allowlist entry equals the pin (runtime/utility UI false with a 30+ char reason, everything else true); a generation-mode page never composes an ineligible section.

Every section contract carries a closed source {id, tag, file, lines} (provenance) and semantic {id, category} (taxonomy) with semantic.id == contract id, semantic.category == id prefix, source.id != semantic id.

Measured at 1440px: HERO > 1800px warns, > 3000px fails; one in-flow non-SHELL section > 50% of its page warns, > 60% fails (pages with >= 3 in-flow sections); missing measurement fails; whitelist entries need a reviewer, a 30+ char justification and a cap.

retiredRules.HERO_FOLLOWS_NAV: replaced by HERO_OPENS_PAGE (generalised to every template with a hero)
retiredRules.FAQ_PRECEDES_DEMO_FORM: merged into DEMO_FORM_PLACEMENT; the constraint moved from conversion.faq (which now precedes the demo CTA or other blocks on subpages) to conversion.demo-form
